options.A: The altitude of the NCP is your angular distance from the North Pole.
options.B: The azimuth of the NCP is your angular distance from the equator.
options.C: The altitude of the NCP is your angular distance from the equator.
options.D: The altitude of the NCP is the same as your latitude.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The altitude of the NCP is the same as your latitude.
